panels.title: HORAS / PERÍODO
panels.description: Último contador menos contador inicial. Prefere base anterior compatível ao filtro; caso contrário usa a primeira leitura interna. * = cobertura parcial ou queda intermediária; não representa total comprovado após reset. A resposta da consulta informa contadores, horários e motivo. Divisor_Horas/Divisor_Energia ajustam as escalas.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prior AS (
 SELECT "time",mdb36::numeric AS value FROM $Id_Logsis
 WHERE "time" <= $__timeFrom() AND mdb36>=0 AND mdb36 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295)
 ORDER BY "time" DESC,mdb36 ASC LIMIT 1
), first_inside AS (
 SELECT "time",mdb36::numeric AS value FROM $Id_Logsis
 WHERE "time">=$__timeFrom() AND "time"<=$__timeTo()
 AND mdb36>=0 AND mdb36 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) ORDER BY "time",mdb36 ASC LIMIT 1
), bounds AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM prior)<=(SELECT value FROM first_inside)
 THEN (SELECT "time" FROM prior) ELSE (SELECT "time" FROM first_inside) END AS base_time,
 CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prior) THEN 'SEM BASE ANTERIOR'
 WHEN (SELECT value FROM prior)>(SELECT value FROM first_inside) THEN 'BASE ANTERIOR INCOMPATÍVEL'
 ELSE 'BASE ANTERIOR' END AS base_kind
), samples AS (
 SELECT "time", MIN(mdb36::numeric) AS value,
 MIN(mdb36::numeric)<>MAX(mdb36::numeric) AS conflicting
 FROM $Id_Logsis
 WHERE "time">=(SELECT base_time FROM bounds) AND "time"<=$__timeTo()
 AND mdb36>=0 AND mdb36 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) GROUP BY "time"
), steps AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY "time") AS previous FROM samples
), totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS samples, COALESCE(BOOL_OR(conflicting),false) AS conflicting,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value<previous) AS drops,
 MIN("time") AS base_time,MAX("time") AS final_time,
 (ARRAY_AGG(value ORDER BY "time"))[1] AS base_raw,
 (ARRAY_AGG(value ORDER BY "time" DESC))[1] AS final_raw
 FROM steps
), result AS (
 SELECT *, (final_raw-base_raw)/NULLIF((${Divisor_Horas:sqlstring})::numeric,0) AS delta,
 CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM first_inside) THEN 'SEM LEITURAS'
 WHEN samples<2 THEN 'FALTA 2ª LEITURA'
 WHEN conflicting THEN 'DADO CONFLITANTE'
 WHEN final_raw<base_raw THEN 'RESET / REVISAR'
 WHEN (${Divisor_Horas:sqlstring})::numeric IS NULL OR (${Divisor_Horas:sqlstring})::numeric<=0 THEN 'DIVISOR INVÁLIDO'
 WHEN drops>0 THEN 'VARIAÇÃO LÍQUIDA / HOUVE QUEDA'
 WHEN (SELECT base_kind FROM bounds)<>'BASE ANTERIOR' THEN 'PARCIAL'
 ELSE 'OK' END AS status
 FROM totals
)
SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('OK','PARCIAL','VARIAÇÃO LÍQUIDA / HOUVE QUEDA') THEN delta END AS "HORAS_PERIODO",
 CASE WHEN status IN ('OK','PARCIAL','VARIAÇÃO LÍQUIDA / HOUVE QUEDA') THEN ROUND(delta,2)::text || ' h' || CASE WHEN status<>'OK' THEN ' *' ELSE '' END
 ELSE status END AS "EXIBICAO", status AS "SITUACAO",
 base_time AS "INICIO_USADO",final_time AS "FIM_USADO",base_raw AS "CONTADOR_INICIAL",final_raw AS "CONTADOR_FINAL",
 (SELECT "time" FROM prior) AS "HORARIO_BASE_ANTERIOR",(SELECT value FROM prior) AS "BASE_ANTERIOR_BRUTA",
 (SELECT base_kind FROM bounds) AS "CRITERIO_BASE",samples AS "AMOSTRAS",drops AS "QUEDAS"
FROM result

SELECT "time" AS "time",CASE WHEN mdb1 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb1 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN (mdb1::numeric)/NULLIF((100)::numeric,0) ELSE NULL END AS "Pressão óleo",CASE WHEN mdb2 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb2 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN mdb2::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "Temp. água",CASE WHEN mdb3 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb3 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN mdb3::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "Temp. óleo",CASE WHEN mdb4 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb4 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN mdb4::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "Nível diesel",CASE WHEN mdb5 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb5 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN (mdb5::numeric)/NULLIF((10)::numeric,0) ELSE NULL END AS "Alternador DC",CASE WHEN mdb6 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb6 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN (mdb6::numeric)/NULLIF((10)::numeric,0) ELSE NULL END AS "Tensão bateria",CASE WHEN mdb7 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb7 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN mdb7::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "RPM motor" FROM $Id_Logsis WHERE $__timeFilter("time") ORDER BY "time"

SELECT "time" AS "time",CASE WHEN mdb40 NOT IN (-2147483648,2147483647,4294967295) AND mdb40 BETWEEN -32759 AND 32759 THEN CASE WHEN mdb40=${Codigo_STOP:sqlstring}::numeric THEN 0 WHEN mdb40=${Codigo_AUTO:sqlstring}::numeric THEN 1 WHEN mdb40=${Codigo_MANUAL:sqlstring}::numeric THEN 2 WHEN mdb40=${Codigo_TESTE_CARGA:sqlstring}::numeric THEN 3 WHEN mdb40=${Codigo_TESTE_SEM_CARGA:sqlstring}::numeric THEN 6 WHEN mdb40=${Codigo_OFF:sqlstring}::numeric THEN 7 ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END AS "Modo operação",CASE WHEN mdb52 IN (0,1) THEN mdb52::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "Disjuntor / GCB" FROM $Id_Logsis WHERE $__timeFilter("time") ORDER BY "time"

SELECT "time" AS "time",CASE WHEN mdb41 IN (0,1) THEN mdb41::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "Warning",CASE WHEN mdb42 IN (0,1) THEN mdb42::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "Trip elétrico",CASE WHEN mdb43 IN (0,1) THEN mdb43::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "Shutdown" FROM $Id_Logsis WHERE $__timeFilter("time") ORDER BY "time"
